name: 33708 · Madeira Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33708 (Madeira Beach) has 59 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 25 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33708 (Madeira Beach) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
